summary: Gunslinger campaign prototype, plus the Green Lantern and Frieren updates from v41.50/v41.51.
notes: Explore The Crossroads with NPC dialogue, an Outlaw encounter and a practice target
Local saves, finite ammunition, three presets, inventory, bandages and exploration shooting
Mini-map, device settings, weapon/encounter presentation and embedded campaign music
Includes Green Lantern and Frieren reworks and the 450–800 ms Black Flash window
Both multiplayer files must support protocol 88; original solo routes remain available
